title: Asset service
interface: Exceptions AssetValidationError(ValueError), DuplicateAssetTag(ValueError). class AssetService(assets: AssetRepository, audit: AuditRepository, tags: TagRepository | None = None, locations: LocationRepository | None = None, invoices: InvoiceRepository | None = None, tag_prefixes: dict | None = None, tag_pad: int = 4) — stored as public attributes. next_asset_tag(type) -> str: prefix = tag_prefixes.get(type) or tag_prefixes.get('other') or 'AS'; the next number = 1 + the highest existing numeric suffix among assets whose asset_tag starts with '<prefix>-' (parse int after the dash, ignore non-numeric); zero-padded to tag_pad. create(actor, asset_tag, type, brand, model, serial_number, purchase_date, price, notes, location_id=None, condition='good', supplier='', warranty_until='', cost_center='', invoice_id=None, invoice_number='', tag_names=None) -> dict: asset_tag stripped/upper-cased and, when empty, generated with next_asset_tag(type); type in ASSET_TYPES; condition in ASSET_CONDITIONS; purchase_date and warranty_until '' or ISO date; price -> float; location_id must exist (locations.get) when given; invoice_id must exist when given; invoice_number (non-empty) -> invoices.get_by_number or invoices.create(number, supplier=supplier, issued_at='', total=0, currency='CZK', notes='', created_by=actor) and used as invoice_id; sqlite3.IntegrityError -> DuplicateAssetTag; tag_names -> for each name: tags.get_by_name or tags.create(name, 'gray'), then tags.set_for_asset; audit 'asset.created'; returns get(id). get(id) -> dict | None enriched with 'tags' (list of tag dicts, [] when no tag repo) and 'invoice' (invoice dict or None). update(actor, asset_id, **fields) -> dict: same validation for the given fields; tag_names (when given) replaces the tag set; invoice_number as in create; unknown id -> AssetValidationError; audit 'asset.updated' with the changed keys. retire/mark_lost(actor, asset_id) -> dict as before (refuse assigned/pending). list(status=None, type=None, q='') -> list[dict]. bulk_tag(actor, asset_ids, tag_name, remove=False) -> int (count of assets changed; creates the tag when needed). attach_invoice(actor, asset_ids, invoice_id) -> int (invoice must exist; sets invoice_id on each; audit once). Never catch generic Exception.

uses.config constants: src/config.py: ASSET_TYPES, ASSET_STATUSES, ASSET_CONDITIONS, TAG_COLORS, ATTACHMENT_KINDS, ATTACHMENT_OWNERS, ATTACHMENT_ALLOWED_TYPES, HANDOVER_KINDS, HANDOVER_STATUSES

notes: Also exercised by tests/test_service_assets_v2.py, tests/test_invoices.py, tests/test_tag_numbering_and_intake.py.
